headword: {燃料補給|ねんりょうほきゅう}

definitions.gloss: refueling; fuel supply; act of supplying fuel to a vehicle, aircraft, or ship
definitions.explanation: Supplying fuel — gasoline, jet fuel, bunker oil, and so on — to a vehicle or vessel. Common in aviation, shipping, military, and road-transport contexts. The word can also be used metaphorically for refilling other "reserves."

examples.japanese: ⟦{飛行機|ひこうき}→飛行機：00629_hikouki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{燃料補給|ねんりょうほきゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{着陸|ちゃくりく}→着陸：05982_chakuriku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{艦船|かんせん}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{燃料補給|ねんりょうほきゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海上|かいじょう}→海上：09799_kaijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧だ。
examples.english: Refueling ships is possible even at sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長距離|ちょうきょり}→長距離：09271_choukyori⟧⟦トラック→トラック：03863_torakku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運転手|うんてんしゅ}→運転手：01333_untenshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦サービスエリア→サービスエリア：11333_saabisueria⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{燃料補給|ねんりょうほきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Long-haul truck drivers refuel at designated service areas.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{燃料|ねんりょう}→燃料：13461_nenryou⟧ (fuel) and ⟦{補給|ほきゅう}→補給：14055_hokyuu⟧ (replenishment, supply). It behaves as a noun and often takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb ({燃料補給|ねんりょうほきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, "to refuel"). Register is neutral-formal and the word is standard in news, military reporting, and technical writing; in casual speech speakers are more likely to say ⟦{給油|きゅうゆ}→給油：18553_kyuuyu⟧ for cars at a gas station.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {燃料補給|ねんりょうほきゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to refuel
- {燃料補給|ねんりょうほきゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to carry out refueling
- ⟦{空中|くうちゅう}→空中：21842_kuuchuu⟧{燃料補給|ねんりょうほきゅう}: in-flight refueling
- {燃料補給|ねんりょうほきゅう}⟦{基地|きち}→基地：03982_kichi⟧: refueling base
- {燃料補給|ねんりょうほきゅう}⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧: refueling aircraft (tanker plane)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{給油|きゅうゆ}→給油：18553_kyuuyu⟧: refueling (with oil or gasoline) — the everyday word for filling up a car
- ⟦{補給|ほきゅう}→補給：14055_hokyuu⟧: replenishment, resupply — general term, not limited to fuel
- ⟦ガソリン→ガソリン：01346_gasorin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put in gas — the most casual conversational phrasing
- ⟦{満|まん}タン→満タン：24454_mantan⟧: full tank — casual; what you ask for at a gas station
